sentences.s: Do you remember all those years when scientists argued that smoking would kill us but the doubters insisted that we didn't know for sure?

components.中文翻译: 证据并不确凿

sentences.zh: （怀疑者们还坚称）证据并不确凿、科学结论尚不确定？

sentences.s: That the antismoking lobby was out to destroy our way of life and the government should stay out of the way?

sentences.zh: 许多美国人相信了那套胡言，而在三十多年间，约有一千万吸烟者过早地走进了坟墓。

components.原文: to tell us that the Earth's atmosphere is definitely warming and that the problem is largely man-made
